operationSelection.description: This kind has a single query form; author it against the `default` contract.

query.description: One Redis command as a space-delimited string, e.g. PING, SCAN 0 MATCH cache:* COUNT 50, TYPE cache:one, GET cache:one, or HGETALL cache:one. The plugin splits on literal spaces; it does not parse shell quoting or multiline scripts.

notes: Redis uses one default query contract and no operation selector. An empty named-operations list does not mean the datasource is unavailable.

Discover actual keys with SCAN, then TYPE and type-appropriate reads. Continue the returned cursor until 0 if full discovery is needed; COUNT is a hint, not a guaranteed page size. Do not use KEYS for discovery.
Scalar and bounded range reads can run directly. SCAN and whole collection reads require singular run_query with confirmed read access, not run_queries. Writes only belong to explicit user actions.
Responses depend on the command: GET is string or null; HGETALL is an alternating field/value array; SCAN returns [cursor, keys]. Parse only the observed structure.
